title: Lottie
summary: Small vector accents in the theme look: thin bone-white line-work on near-black with one rose accent, generated from code in lottie/generate.mjs. They flicker in stepped frames or creep slowly; nothing bounces.

items.name: Rec blink
items.description: A blinking record light inside corner brackets.

items.name: Signal lost
items.description: Signal bars dropping out one by one, then a rose cross.

items.name: Static bars
items.description: Stuttering horizontal bars of noise, one of them rose.

items.name: Scan frame
items.description: A rose beam passing up and down over a figure inside flickering brackets.

items.name: Pulse line
items.description: A heart-monitor trace drawn across by a bright head.

items.name: Warning
items.description: A triangle with a flickering mark and a fading echo.

items.name: Eye open
items.description: An eye that opens, looks one way, then the other, and closes.

items.name: Cross out
items.description: A line of text struck through twice in rose.

items.name: Bulb flicker
items.description: A bare hanging bulb whose glow dips and cuts out.

items.name: Candle
items.description: A candle with a flame that leans and gutters.

items.name: Moon and cloud
items.description: A moon with a breathing halo and two bands of cloud drifting across.

items.name: Clock tick
items.description: A clock whose second hand ticks toward a mark, then sticks and twitches.

items.name: Door creak
items.description: A door easing open on a flickering cold light.

items.name: Key turn
items.description: A key sliding into a lock plate and turning with a click.

items.name: Magnifier
items.description: A magnifying glass passing over lines of text until it finds something.
